NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ongdalsaem uses your rough location to show today’s weather and dishes cooked nearby. Your exact location is never shown to others.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ongdalsaem uses your photos so you can share dishes you cooked or ate.
NSCameraUsageDescription: ongdalsaem uses the camera so you can take a photo of your dish.
